exposure: delivery in centres without surgical facilities
cohort: The cohort consisted of 332 adolescent mothers aged 13-19 years who delivered at the Sylvanus Olympio University Hospital Centre (CHU-SO) in Lome, Togo.
finding: Adolescent mothers are at a significant risk of maternal and neonatal complications during childbirth, with these risks exacerbated by poor antenatal care and attempted deliveries in facilities without surgical capabilities.
